/obj/item/ammo_box/a357.name: speed loader (.357)
/obj/item/ammo_box/a357.reason: Plain 60 damage for a yellow revolver. Follows the gun; the ammo itself is cheap and prints with little research.

/obj/item/ammo_box/a357/heartseeker.name: speed loader (.357 Heartseeker)
/obj/item/ammo_box/a357/heartseeker.reason: 50 damage that steers itself onto the target. Hard to dodge, still stopped by a vest, so it stays with the gun.

/obj/item/ammo_box/a357/match.name: speed loader (.357 Match)
/obj/item/ammo_box/a357/match.reason: 60 damage with long bounces that seek targets. The best normal .357.

/obj/item/ammo_box/a357/phasic.name: speed loader (.357 Phasic)
/obj/item/ammo_box/a357/phasic.reason: 35 damage that ignores armor and flies through walls and doors. More damage per second than the red X-ray gun, from any .357 revolver.

/obj/item/ammo_box/a40mm.name: ammo box (40mm grenades)
/obj/item/ammo_box/a40mm.note: On hit it explodes at the target: light-severity blast out to 2 tiles, fire out to 3 and a flash at 1, with no heavy or devastating ring. It affects everything in range, the shooter included.
/obj/item/ammo_box/a40mm.reason: 60 damage and a light blast with fire around the target. Hurts a room, cannot open a hull. Only the M-90 can fire it.

/obj/item/ammo_box/c10mm.name: ammo box (10mm)
/obj/item/ammo_box/c10mm.reason: Plain 40 damage. The only guns that take it are the near-useless Liberator and, by hand, the Condor magazine, so a box does little.

/obj/item/ammo_box/c38.name: speed loader (.38)
/obj/item/ammo_box/c38.reason: Plain 25 damage for a green revolver. Prints at round start.

/obj/item/ammo_box/c38/dumdum.name: speed loader (.38 DumDum)
/obj/item/ammo_box/c38/dumdum.reason: 15 damage that often sticks in the target and tears them up. Great on bare skin, poor against any armor.

/obj/item/ammo_box/c38/flare.name: speed loader (.38 Flare)
/obj/item/ammo_box/c38/flare.note: Ignites a carbon target only if it already has fire stacks; the beam adds none. Hitting a wall only changes the impact effect. / Same as the plain laser, plus a living target is marked as a designated target for 2 minutes (refreshed by each hit): a red outline and a glow, and shots against it keep their aimed body zone at any range. Getting wet removes the mark.
/obj/item/ammo_box/c38/flare.reason: 20 damage laser round that marks the target with a red glow for 2 minutes. Handy, not fight-winning, so its rep 11 print is high.

/obj/item/ammo_box/c38/hotshot.name: speed loader (.38 Hot Shot)
/obj/item/ammo_box/c38/hotshot.note: Adds 6 fire stacks to and ignites any carbon hit, armor or not. It leaves no flaming trail.
/obj/item/ammo_box/c38/hotshot.reason: Sets anyone hit on fire with 6 fire stacks, armor or not. Turns a green revolver into a real threat without a fire suit.

/obj/item/ammo_box/c38/iceblox.name: speed loader (.38 Iceblox)
/obj/item/ammo_box/c38/iceblox.note: A hit on any living mob sets its body temperature to 100 K in one step, scaled down by its armor percentage. It is not a gradual chill.
/obj/item/ammo_box/c38/iceblox.reason: One hit freezes the target, down to about 160 K through a vest, which slows them hard and keeps hurting. Yellow power on a green revolver.

/obj/item/ammo_box/c38/match.name: speed loader (.38 Match)
/obj/item/ammo_box/c38/match.reason: Plain 25 damage with far better bounces off walls. A small upgrade on a weak gun.

/obj/item/ammo_box/c38/match/bouncy.name: speed loader (.38 Rubber)
/obj/item/ammo_box/c38/match/bouncy.reason: 10 damage and 30 stamina with wild bounces. A cheap less-lethal round.

/obj/item/ammo_box/c38/trac.name: speed loader (.38 TRAC)
/obj/item/ammo_box/c38/trac.note: Implants a tracking implant in any carbon it hits, armor or not, unless one is already present. The implant shows on prisoner management consoles and self-destructs after 5 minutes.
/obj/item/ammo_box/c38/trac.reason: 10 damage and plants a tracker that lasts 5 minutes, readable on a prisoner console. Niche.

/obj/item/ammo_box/c38/true.name: speed loader (.38 True Strike)
/obj/item/ammo_box/c38/true.reason: 15 damage that curves toward a target after bouncing. A trick shot, weaker than plain .38 in a straight fight.

/obj/item/ammo_box/c45.name: ammo box (.45)
/obj/item/ammo_box/c45.reason: Box or loose round that fits the green M1911, and hand-fills C-20r and Thompson magazines too. Every autolathe prints the box from round start on purpose.

/obj/item/ammo_box/c9mm.name: ammo box (9mm)
/obj/item/ammo_box/c9mm.reason: 30 plain rounds or one loose round for any 9mm gun, all of them yellow. Every autolathe prints the box from round start on purpose, so the gun is the real gate.

/obj/item/ammo_box/cyberware_buster_rock.name: Buster rocket pair
/obj/item/ammo_box/cyberware_buster_rock.note: The blast is only a visual and a sound at the impact point; it damages nothing in a radius. Damage to objects is multiplied by 8 (demolition_mod), and a living target is knocked down for 1 second.
/obj/item/ammo_box/cyberware_buster_rock.reason: Two reloads for the Bunker Buster arm: 60 damage, a knockdown, and eight times the damage to doors and machines.

/obj/item/ammo_box/magazine/m12g/bioterr.name: shotgun magazine (12g bioterror)

On a non-carbon target the chems simply react at impact.

/obj/item/ammo_box/magazine/m12g/donk.name: shotgun magazine (12g Donk Co. 'Donk Spike' flechette)
/obj/item/ammo_box/magazine/m12g/donk.reason: Eight weak flechette shells. Fits only the Bulldog, so it follows the gun, but it is the worst way to load one.

Each object hit takes 80 brute and closed turfs, reinforced ones included, are scraped away unless indestructible, which also costs it extra damage. Living hits are paralyzed for 5 seconds and stuttered; the meteorslug subtype instead paralyzes 1 second, knocks down 8 and travels only 7 tiles.
/obj/item/ammo_box/magazine/m12g/meteor.reason: Eight meteor slugs: knockdown on every hit and a wall gone per shot, in bursts.

/obj/item/ammo_box/magazine/m12g/slug.name: shotgun magazine (12g slugs)
/obj/item/ammo_box/magazine/m12g/slug.reason: Eight 50 damage slugs that cancel a vest. The Bulldog's killing load.

/obj/item/ammo_box/magazine/m12g/stun.name: shotgun magazine (12g taser slugs)

/obj/item/ammo_casing/shotgun/frag12.reason: 15 damage, 1 second paralysis and a small blast at the target. Useful, but the blast is light and reaches one tile.

/obj/item/ammo_casing/shotgun/incapacita.name: custom incapacitating shot
/obj/item/ammo_casing/shotgun/incapacita.reason: 12 pellets of 6 stamina. Rubber shot by another name, only good in someone's face.

/obj/item/ammo_casing/shotgun/incendiary.name: incendiary slug
/obj/item/ammo_casing/shotgun/incendiary.note: Adds fire stacks to any carbon it hits and ignites them, whatever their armor; the amount varies by calibre (4 by default, 1 to 3 on the pistol, SMG and 7mm kinds). In flight it drops a hotspot on every tile it crosses (except the no-trail slug), which can light gas and flammables along its path.
/obj/item/ammo_casing/shotgun/incendiary.reason: 20 damage and 4 fire stacks with a burning trail. Prints at round start, yet it hits like the yellow fire loads.

/obj/item/ammo_casing/shotgun/incendiary.name: precision incendiary slug
/obj/item/ammo_casing/shotgun/incendiary.note: Adds fire stacks to any carbon it hits and ignites them, whatever their armor; the amount varies by calibre (4 by default, 1 to 3 on the pistol, SMG and 7mm kinds). In flight it drops a hotspot on every tile it crosses (except the no-trail slug), which can light gas and flammables along its path.
/obj/item/ammo_casing/shotgun/incendiary.reason: 35 damage and 4 fire stacks with no fire trail behind it, so it is safer to use on your own ship.

/obj/item/ammo_casing/shotgun/ion.name: ion shell
/obj/item/ammo_casing/shotgun/ion.note: Does no damage; on any hit it sets off an EMP at the impact tile. That tile takes a heavy EMP and each tile one step out takes a heavy or light one (50/50), reaching everything on them including the shooter if close. The reduced-radius variant (HoS ion casing, ion shell) has radius 0, so only the impact tile is hit, heavy or light 50/50.
/obj/item/ammo_casing/shotgun/ion.reason: Four small EMP bolts. Bad news for borgs, suits and energy guns, nothing to a bare man.

/obj/item/ammo_casing/shotgun/meteorslug.name: meteorslug shell
/obj/item/ammo_casing/shotgun/meteorslug.note: Pierces everything, losing 10 damage per hit and stopping once it drops below 40 (10 for the meteorslug). Each object hit takes 80 brute and closed turfs, reinforced ones included, are scraped away unless indestructible, which also costs it extra damage. Living hits are paralyzed for 5 seconds and stuttered; the meteorslug subtype instead paralyzes 1 second, knocks down 8 and travels only 7 tiles.
/obj/item/ammo_casing/shotgun/meteorslug.reason: 40 damage, 1 second paralysis and 8 second knockdown. Also punches through mobs and scrapes away a wall per shot, reinforced ones included.

/obj/item/ammo_casing/shotgun/milspec.name: shotgun milspec slug
/obj/item/ammo_casing/shotgun/milspec.reason: 50 damage that cancels a vest. Twice a normal slug and the hardest plain hit a shotgun has.

/obj/item/ammo_casing/shotgun/no_quarter.name: heavy cartridge
/obj/item/ammo_casing/shotgun/no_quarter.note: A living target is thrown 6 tiles and knocked down for 2 seconds, armor or not. A plain wall is dismantled outright and the slug can hit turfs, but a reinforced wall only shows a 'too tough' alert and is untouched.
/obj/item/ammo_casing/shotgun/no_quarter.reason: Cartridge for the "No Quarter". Paper and iron make it on purpose, and it fits nothing else, so the gun is the gate.

/obj/item/ammo_casing/shotgun/pulseslug.name: pulse slug
/obj/item/ammo_casing/shotgun/pulseslug.note: A hit on a turf or a structure (walls, grilles, windows, lockers) also queues a heavy-severity explosion on that one thing, on top of the shot's damage. Mobs and machines get no extra blast.
/obj/item/ammo_casing/shotgun/pulseslug.reason: 30 laser damage, and any wall or structure it hits takes a heavy blast. A hole in a hull per shell.

/obj/item/ammo_casing/shotgun/pulverizer.name: pulverizer slug
/obj/item/ammo_casing/shotgun/pulverizer.reason: Normal slug damage with a huge wound bonus: shatters bones.

/obj/item/ammo_casing/shotgun/rubbershot.name: rubber shot
/obj/item/ammo_casing/shotgun/rubbershot.reason: 60 stamina and a little damage across 6 pellets that bounce off walls. The working less-lethal shell.

/obj/item/ammo_casing/shotgun/scatterlas.name: scatter laser shell
/obj/item/ammo_casing/shotgun/scatterlas.reason: 45 laser damage across 6 pellets. Half again what buckshot does, and strongest up close.

/obj/item/ammo_casing/shotgun/stunslug.name: taser slug
/obj/item/ammo_casing/shotgun/stunslug.reason: One hit paralyzes for 10 seconds, about 7 through a vest, out to 7 tiles, from any shotgun. The same stun that makes the sniper rifle red.

/obj/item/ammo_casing/shotgun/techshell.name: unloaded technological shell
/obj/item/ammo_casing/shotgun/techshell.reason: Rates as what it becomes: a screwdriver and common parts turn this blank into a pulse, meteor, FRAG-12, dragon's breath or ion shell, with no research beyond the blank itself.

/obj/item/ammo_casing/spent.name: spent bullet casing
/obj/item/ammo_casing/spent.reason: An empty case. Only useful to the handloader's vise.

/obj/item/ammo_casing/strilka310.name: .310 Strilka bullet casing
/obj/item/ammo_casing/strilka310.reason: Real .310: about 47 damage through a vest against 24 for surplus rounds. This clip alone is what separates the green surplus rifle from the yellow Sakhno.

/obj/item/ammo_casing/strilka310/phasic.name: .310 Strilka phasic bullet casing
/obj/item/ammo_casing/strilka310/phasic.reason: Full 60 damage through walls and doors, from any .310 rifle including the 900 cr surplus one. Three times the hit of the red X-ray gun.

/obj/item/ammo_casing/strilka310/surplus.name: .310 Strilka surplus bullet casing
/obj/item/ammo_casing/strilka310/surplus.reason: Surplus rounds, 60 on bare skin and about 24 through a vest. Every autolathe prints them from round start; they feed a green rifle.

/obj/item/ammo_casing/syringegun.name: syringe gun spring
/obj/item/ammo_casing/syringegun.note: Fires the first loaded syringe. At full power the syringe is destroyed and its contents go into the dart, which takes the syringe's name, injection flags and armour penetration; at low power the whole syringe rides in the dart and, if it embeds, slowly injects, otherwise it drops where the shot lands. With no syringe loaded the dart carries nothing. / Carries up to 50 units of reagents, held inert in flight. A hit on a carbon whose hit zone can be injected (thick suits block it unless the dart pierces) injects all of it; otherwise the dart is deflected for no damage and the chems react inside it. On a non-carbon target the chems simply react at impact. / A dart carrying the loaded syringe: its reagents are allowed to react in flight, unlike a plain dart. A syringe that did not embed drops to the floor where the shot lands or runs out.
/obj/item/ammo_casing/syringegun.reason: The spring inside every syringe gun, never on its own. Rated with the plain syringe gun.

method: A round takes the tier of the guns that fire it, using the gun ratings; a box or loose round that fits several guns takes the lowest real one, so a crew holding that gun can feed it. It moves up only where the round itself is the power (walls, one-hit stuns, fire, blast), plain common rounds for green guns are none, and lenses and built-in magazines copy their gun.
